statement: Malaria is caused by exposure to too much sunlight or heat, and not by mosquito bites.
Eating excess oily or fatty food causes malaria.
Malaria can be transmitted from one person to another through touch.
A single episode of malaria gives a person lifelong immunity against future infections.
Herbal concoctions alone are sufficient to cure malaria, without the need for orthodox treatment.
Mosquito nets are only necessary during the rainy season.
Taking antimalarial drugs regularly, even without symptoms, is a safe way to prevent malaria.
Malaria is a spiritual affliction that cannot be prevented through physical protective measures.
